sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Dry Bulk Marine Transport and Brokerage of Granular Elemental Sulfur

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive DTAA/BIT network in force; limited investment protections may exist under the Compact of Free Association with the United States and selected Asia-Pacific regional instruments.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: RMI Revised Code Title 27 (Business Corporations Act), Title 43 (Money Laundering Prevention and Prohibition Act), Title 30 (Banking Act) and the Beneficial Ownership Rules 2022; FATF/APG-aligned AML/CFT Regulations promulgated by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; Registrar of Corporations Directive No. 2023-01 on Beneficial Ownership disclosures.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport / Government-Issued ID for each Director, Shareholder and Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of original document issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Proof of Residential Address (Utility Bill or Bank Statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility company or licensed bank in the UBO/director's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from a licensed financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: International or Upper-tier commercial bank maintaining the applicant account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Register of Directors and Certificate of Incumbency / Register of Members
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction corporate registry or licensed registered agent (for corporate UBO chains)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Irrevocable Power of Attorney appointing the RMI Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or barrister/solicitor in the appointer's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every UBO, director, secretary and authorized signatory against the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit consolidated list, UN Security Council sanctions list, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, EU consolidated list and HM Treasury consolidated list, using automated and human verification. Politically Exposed Persons (foreign, domestic and international organization PEPs) and their family/close associates require completion of enhanced due diligence (EDD), including documented source of wealth and source of funds, and must be approved by senior management of the RMI registered agent before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry Online Name Reservation Portal (Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Consumer Affairs); available directly to licensed registered agents
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Latin script (A-Z) and may contain Marshallese diacritics only if a transliteration is also provided. The distinct legal name must be expressed in English or Marshallese and may include only permitted suffixes such as 'Corporation', 'Inc.', 'Limited' or 'Ltd.'. Chinese, Cyrillic or Arabic-script names without official transliteration are not accepted.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name reservation is rejected, the applicant or registered agent may submit a written re-reservation request within seven business days. The request must state the exact proposed name, enclose the prior rejection notice and, where relevant, evidence of prior authorization from the Ministry of Commerce for sensitive tokens. Rejections based on resemblance to a protected name can be appealed using Form RC-05 (Name Appeal) to the Registrar, with a copy to the RMI Administrative Appeals Tribunal; if no substantive response is issued within 20 business days, the proposed name is treated as withdrawn and a new name must be filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a non-resident Business Corporation in this industry. A virtual office address may be provided by the licensed RMI registered agent and no substantive physical presence or business license is required for the brokerage and transport booking of granular elemental sulfur. The registered office must be physically located in Majuro or Ebeye and operate during normal business hours for service of process.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk (under 5% annual probability) for a clean, tax-exempt non-resident entity engaged in low-risk mineral trading; regular unannounced inspections are not performed unless triggered by a suspicious transaction report, regulatory non-compliance, or an adverse FIU risk alert.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI

Prevailing market benchmark for standard virtual office

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of 1986, Title 51, Marshall Islands Revised Statutes (as amended); sections governing incorporation, registered office, registered agent, directors, and officers
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; incorporation may proceed with zero paid-up capital. No escrow account is required. Shares may be fully unpaid until the initial subscriber advances funds.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation adopts its Articles of Incorporation as registered and declares its purpose to conduct dry bulk marine transport and brokerage of granular elemental sulfur; that the registered office and registered agent shown in the Articles are approved; that the earlier subscription agreement for initial shares is ratified and a quorum of directors authorized the issuance of the subscribed shares; that the following officers are appointed, namely Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary; and that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, obtain tax certificates or exemptions, execute cargo-related contracts, and complete all filings necessary to operate lawfully in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Corporate Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search against the corporate register; submit a name reservation application in the prescribed registry form together with the required fee through an accredited agent or the registry e-portal.
required_dossiers: Identification of the applicant (incorporator or authorized agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict, file an amended reservation or submit a written consent and clearance letter from the existing nameholder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Attorney or Notary Public in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare Articles of Incorporation containing the corporate name, authorized purposes, share structure, name and address of the initial director, and registered office and registered agent. Have the incorporator execute the Articles and notarize the signature page.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar identifies a substantive defect, prepare and file corrective amendments and an explanatory cover letter within the Registry's notice period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Filing Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Articles of Incorporation and the statutory filing fee through the registry window or the authorized e-filing portal; obtain an official stamped receipt or electronic acknowledgement of filing.
required_dossiers: Letter of authorization from the incorporator or director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query is issued, respond within thirty days with a corrective statement; if the fee was deficient, pay the assessed surcharge and resubmit the filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a registered office located in the Republic of the Marshall Islands and a licensed registered agent; file the registered agent's written acceptance, the registered office address, and the formal notice of appointment with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent resigns or the registered office is invalid, file an immediate change of registered agent or office with the Registrar and pay the corresponding amendment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Corporate Governance and Tax Status Documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations / Marshall Islands Tax Authority or Authorized Corporate Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, convene the first organizational meeting, adopt the minutes, appoint officers, and file all initial governance consents. Submit the tax registration or non-resident tax exemption application, as appropriate, for a non-resident business corporation.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first organizational meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax status is queried, submit documentary evidence of non-resident activity and offshore source income, or file an administrative appeal with the Marshall Islands Tax Authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no physical industrial undertaking in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; vessel registration and maritime compliance, if required, would be handled by the RMI Maritime Administrator
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no operating license required for a non-resident business corporation engaged in brokerage and commercial trading without a local physical establishment

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Agency of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / No EIA required for offshore brokerage and dry bulk marine transport trading activities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or solid waste discharge is generated by the corporate trading entity; if a physical storage or handling facility is later established in the RMI, compliance with the RMI Environmental Protection Act and MARPOL discharge and emission standards would become mandatory.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for an offshore non-resident trading vehicle. Should the corporation lease administrative office space in Majuro, the premises must pass fire safety inspection by the Majuro Fire Department and obtain occupancy and workplace health clearance from the Ministry of Health.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Office (RTO), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; official portal: https://rmigovernment.org (RMI Tax Self-Service)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident Business Corporations (BCs) under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act are not automatically issued a TIN. The BC files Form RMI-TIN-01 with the RTO, accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent confirmation, and a statutory declaration of non-resident status confirming the absence of RMI-source business activity. Where no RMI-source income is derived, TIN registration is optional; the BC typically obtains a Tax Exemption Certificate and Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar of Corporations. RTO issuance target: 3–5 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone – Non-resident BC is exempt from RMI income tax on all foreign-source income; any RMI-source business income (if conducted) is subject to 3% gross revenue tax under the Income Tax Act 1989.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist under RMI domestic law. Available election: non-resident exempt status filing under the Business Corporations Act, which once accepted renders the BC exempt from RMI income tax on foreign-source income; no BEPS Action 2 hybrid rules adopted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None – RMI levies no VAT, GST, or general sales and use tax; only customs import duty (Title 51, RMI Revised Code) applies, with no indirect tax imposed on exports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no VAT/GST statute in force; therefore no economic turnover threshold triggering registration exists (official currency: US Dollar).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable – RMI imposes no electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API reporting, or digital stamping mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – RMI has no VAT/GST exported supply mechanism. Exports of granular elemental sulfur by a non-resident BC fall wholly outside the RMI indirect tax base (no output tax, no input VAT credits, no refund claim). Cargo in RMI transit or transshipment is not subject to import duty.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / Cargo Manifest (RMI Customs Service, Title 51)
Bill of Lading (Original or Telex Release)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit advice under Letter of Credit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating refund or clawback regime exists. Key enforcement vectors: (i) false customs export declarations – fines up to USD 10,000 per violation plus forfeiture and penalties under Title 51 RMI Revised Code; (ii) misrepresentation of non-resident exempt status – retroactive assessment of 3% gross revenue tax, interest, and statutory penalties under Title 35; (iii) AML/CFT examination by the Pacific Banking Commission for trade-based money-laundering indicators, including over- or under-invoicing of sulfur cargoes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Banking Commissioner (Ministry of Finance) — no domestic central bank exists; U.S. dollar is legal tender and the Federal Reserve serves as the monetary anchor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands maintains full currency convertibility without exchange-control approvals. Both current and capital account transactions are unrestricted; the absence of a domestic currency eliminates FX matching requirements. Profit remittances may be executed as ordinary dividends unless bank-level AML review identifies UBO or source-of-funds gaps. No prior administrative permit is required for remittances, and there are no statutory capital or current account hurdles beyond routine sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The Marshall Islands imposes no export-proceeds surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio. Export receipts may be retained in USD, parked offshore, or repatriated freely. Banks may apply ordinary OFAC and UNSC sanctions screening on transaction narratives.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMIs are not licensed as deposit-taking institutions in the Republic of the Marshall Islands and cannot provide a local clearing account. They may serve only as auxiliary payment channels for vendor disbursements if the EMI’s correspondent bank accepts the corporate beneficiary package, but the primary treasury rail must be a fully licensed RMI commercial bank account to meet Banking Commissioner expectations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is not mandatory. Remote account opening is permitted when the bank completes a live-interview video KYC or a notarized/certified identity process. Directors must submit certified passports, notarized board resolutions, apostilled corporate good-standing certificates, and benefical ownership declarations; a relationship-manager escalation is required for non-resident directors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident business corporation with no local economic substance and nominee officers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of articles of incorporation, register of directors and shareholders, nominee declaration, registered agent confirmation, and an attested organisational chart explaining the commercial treasury purpose of the non-resident vehicle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexpected capital contribution from a third-country parent or shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorising the contribution, source-of-funds evidence such as audited parent financial statements, transaction tax vouchers, sale contracts, and a bank-purpose narrative identifying the debt-free equity injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume disbursements to bulk-carrier shipping agents and suppliers in multiple jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master sulfur sale contract, charter-party agreements, proforma invoices, bills of lading, and commodity surveyor certificates; together with an OFAC/UNSC sanctions screening report and a transactional AML review confirming the beneficial ownership structure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank cover) addressed to the Bank of Marshall Islands USD account. The payment narrative must state 'Equity injection for sulfur mineral ore trading' and be classified as direct investment equity under the BOP framework. The injecting shareholder must transmit from its own bank account and provide a board resolution when requested. No RMI exchange-control approval is required because no permit regime exists.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For direct supplier and vessel payments, clear via SWIFT MT103 with invoice and charter-party references. For documentary protection, issue an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit via MT700 and settle against compliant shipping documents such as bills of lading, surveyor certificates, and commercial invoices. Supplier payments may be netted under a master sale agreement only when a full audit trail is preserved; MT202 is not to be used as a direct trade-payment rail unless strictly interbank cover.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD-EUR outright forwards with licensed RMI-linked banks or approved correspondents
USD-CNY non-deliverable forwards for offshore Chinese counterparty settlements
Cross-currency swaps between USD and commodity-basket currencies
OTC FX options with neutral margin and credit-rating requirements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Payment under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: on or before the last day of the month of incorporation anniversary; 30-day grace period for payment.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late penalty plus 1% monthly interest; non-payment for 60 days from the deadline triggers administrative strike-off by the Registrar and loss of legal status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit for non-resident business corporations; the Business Corporations Act does not impose public filing or independent audit regardless of turnover or assets. An audit may be required by shareholder resolution, creditor agreement, or if the corporation undertakes regulated financial activity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory domestic accounting framework is prescribed; financial statements, where voluntarily prepared, should adopt IFRS or US GAAP consistently. Books and records must be kept under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No statutory annual UBO declaration or public UBO filing is required under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. Beneficial ownership information is collected and updated by the registered agent under RMI AML/CFT regulations; share transfers are recorded in the register of members on the occurrence of the transfer.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a qualifying non-resident business corporation (NRDC) deriving no RMI-source income; the nominal Marshall Islands corporate tax rate on RMI-source income otherwise is 3%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Marshall Islands income tax for NRDCs under the Business Corporations Act (BCCA) when the corporation derives all income outside the Republic. Foreign-source dividends, interest, royalties, capital gains, and trading profits are outside the RMI tax net. The entity remains subject only to fixed annual business license and annual report fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Marshall Islands Corporate Income Tax Return (CIT-01) filed through the RMI National Revenue E-Portal. An NRDC with no RMI-source income is not required to file CIT-01; annual compliance consists of the BCCA Annual Report (Form AR-21) and Business License Renewal (Form BL-3) filed through the RMI Online Corporate Registry and Business License Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a taxable corporation, the return is due on or before the 30th day of the fourth calendar month following the end of the tax year; for a calendar year taxpayer, 30 April of the following year. The NRDC exemption return, if any, is due on the same schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name of the Marshall Islands business corporation exactly as registered under the BCCA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name shown on the Certificate of Incorporated Business; do not abbreviate trading names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique registration number assigned by the RMI Registrar of Corporations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the six-digit registration number; if the certificate indicates 'NRDC' use the same number with no additional suffix.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the principal administrative office and jurisdiction of management.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the full address outside the Marshall Islands. An NRDC may state a foreign address and must confirm that meetings and management are not held in RMI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the corporation derived no income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands during the tax year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'Yes' where all income is foreign-source; attach a brief schedule identifying the countries of source and the nature of the shipping, brokerage, or trading activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must co-sign the form and confirm the entity is in good standing. The agent must not be listed as a director for a non-directed corporation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing by a taxable corporation attracts a penalty of 5% per month or part of a month on the unpaid tax, capped at 25%, plus interest at 1% per month. Late payment carries an additional 0.5% per month penalty. Failure to file the annual BCCA report or business license renewal results in a USD 250–USD 1,000 penalty and potential administrative strike-off. Wilful failure to file or filing a false exemption declaration may attract criminal fines and imprisonment under Title 30 of the RMI Income Tax Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions made by an NRDC to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. Since no RMI withholding tax is imposed at source, no treaty relief application is required or available in respect of RMI dividends. Where a foreign shareholder seeks a foreign tax credit or a reduced withholding tax in its home jurisdiction, the shareholder must obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its residence tax authority and submit it to the home-country payer or tax authority. If the NRDC is treated as resident in another jurisdiction for treaty purposes, the foreign jurisdiction's DTA determines the applicable WHT rate on payments sourced from that jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border royalty and interest payments made by an NRDC to non-residents. Under applicable foreign tax treaties, royalty WHT may be reduced to 0–10% and interest to 0–15%; portfolio interest is often exempt in jurisdictions applying the US model. No RMI gross-basis tax applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No RMI statutory transfer pricing documentation regime exists; the local file/master file threshold for RMI purposes is USD 0 (not applicable). If a parent or group is subject to OECD BEPS Action 13 rules in another jurisdiction, a master file may be required when worldwide consolidated revenue exceeds USD 750 million, and a local file may be required where intercompany transactions exceed the importing jurisdiction's domestic threshold, commonly USD 250,000–5,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2020 apply to all entities registered under the BCCA that carry on a 'relevant activity', which includes shipping, distribution and service centres, financing and leasing, IP holding, and banking/insurance. A sulfur mineral ore trading and brokerage BC is within scope if it performs core income-generating activities from RMI. The entity must maintain adequate premises, full-time employees, and direction and management in RMI, and must file an annual ESR return. An NRDC with no RMI activity and no RMI-source income can submit a nil declaration, provided it does not claim any RMI economic substance. Non-compliance triggers a penalty of USD 20,000–50,000 and may lead to deregistration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Abusive Exemption Claim
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Booking RMI-source shipping, brokerage, or trading income while claiming the NRDC tax exemption; holding management and control in the Marshall Islands without filing RMI corporate income tax; or using the tax-exempt structure to conceal underlying trade documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of the 3% RMI corporate tax on all RMI-source income, plus 25% accuracy-related penalty and interest at 1% per month. Wilful evasion is punishable as a criminal offence under the RMI Income Tax Act by a fine of up to USD 10,000 and imprisonment for up to three years, together with revocation of the corporate exemption certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false exemption declarations or knowingly divert RMI-source income are jointly and severally liable for the tax, interest, and penalties. Courts may impose civil restitution orders, freeze personal bank accounts, issue travel bans pending final assessment, and in egregious cases impose custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Marshall Islands BC as a conduit for shipments involving sanctioned states or designated parties, processing cargo payments outside the Letter of Credit rail through unlicensed intermediaries, or deliberately failing to record beneficial ownership and transaction documentation as required by RMI AML/CFT law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Counter-Trafficking and AML/CFT Act 2018, a corporate entity may be fined up to USD 100,000 per violation; individuals may be fined up to USD 150,000 and imprisoned for up to ten years. The Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze assets, and the vessel or cargo may be detained by port authorities. U.S. OFAC secondary sanctions may also apply to counterparties in the sulfur trade if the underlying voyage involves Iran, North Korea, Syria, or other sanctioned jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners who knowingly participate in or enable laundering of shipping proceeds are subject to personal criminal liability, asset confiscation, extradition, and travel restrictions. Veil-piercing principles allow the court to look directly at the director's personal assets for restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Misuse of Corporate Form
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining zero substance, no registered agent responsiveness, no books and records, or no CIGA; issuing a bill of lading or certificate of analysis for sulfur mineral ore that misrepresents the vessel, quantity, or loading port; using the NRDC as a mere instrumentality to defraud charterers, sellers, or insurers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Registrar may strike off or revoke the certificate of incorporation after repeated non-compliance. Civil monetary penalties up to USD 10,000 apply for failure to maintain a registered office and annual report. Fraudulent bills of lading also trigger liability under shipping and insurance law, including voiding P&I cover and imposing statutory damages.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts will disregard the separate legal personality of the BC where the directors treated corporate assets as their own or operated the company for a fraudulent purpose. Directors may be held personally liable for all unpaid corporate debts, ordered to make restitution to deceived counterparties, prohibited from acting as directors of any RMI company, and in fraud cases sentenced to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Customs/Trade Misdeclaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manipulating invoice prices between related parties for the sale of granular elemental sulfur; under-declaring the FOB value of the ore in the bill of lading or customs declaration; overpaying or underpricing brokerage commissions to shift profit into the RMI tax-free zone; misclassifying the product under HS code 2503 to circumvent export controls or duties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The importing country may impose transfer pricing adjustments, gross-up taxes, and penalties of 20–40% on the undeclared profit. RMI customs authorities may impose duties and penalties on under-declared cargo, seize the goods, and refer the matter for criminal investigation. A false declaration also exposes the company to civil claims by the buyer or vessel owner under the charterparty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Persons who knowingly sign false invoices or customs declarations are personally liable for penalties in the jurisdiction of import, including criminal fines and imprisonment. Under cross-border mutual legal assistance, personal assets may be frozen or confiscated, and directors may be subject to extradition and travel bans in connection with the fraudulent trade documentation.
